_about: Minimal working example against a public page. Copy it, point 'url' at your running app, and rewrite the steps.

steps.say: This is a narrated demo recorded by the demo video recorder skill. Every step pairs a line of narration with what happens on screen.
steps.caption: One step = one line of narration + on-screen actions

steps.say: Actions can scroll to an element, click, type, or wait. Here it hovers the link at the bottom of the page.
steps.caption: Scroll, click, type, hover, wait
